description: This file declares classes and data structures related to the front panel controls of a device, including LED indicators, blinking behaviors, and preferences handling within the WPEFramework plugin namespace.

classes.name: CFrontPanel
classes.description: Singleton class managing front panel interactions, including LED control, preferences, and event observation.

classes.name: FrontPanelHelper
classes.description: Helper class providing auxiliary functions for the front panel, such as remote LED control.

classes.name: BlinkInfo
classes.description: Class encapsulating blink timing information for the front panel

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of CFrontPanel.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the front panel controls or processes.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the front panel controls or processes.

methods.name: getLastError
methods.description: Retrieves the last error message.

methods.name: addEventObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer for front panel events.

methods.name: removeEventObserver
methods.description: Removes an observer for front panel events.

methods.name: setBrightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness level of the front panel.

methods.name: getBrightness
methods.description: Gets the current brightness level.

methods.name: powerOffLed
methods.description: Turns off a specified front panel LED indicator.

methods.name: powerOnLed
methods.description: Turns on a specified front panel LED indicator.

methods.name: powerOffAllLed
methods.description: Turns off all front panel LEDs.

methods.name: powerOnAllLed
methods.description: Turns on all front panel LEDs.

methods.name: setPowerStatus
methods.description: Sets the power status of the device.

methods.name: getPreferences
methods.description: Retrieves current preferences.

methods.name: setPreferences
methods.description: Sets preferences from a JsonObject.

methods.name: setLED
methods.description: Sets the state of a LED using BlinkInfo data.

methods.name: setBlink
methods.description: Sets blinking behavior based on JsonObject input.

methods.name: loadPreferences
methods.description: Loads preferences from storage.

methods.name: stopBlinkTimer
methods.description: Stops blinking timer.

methods.name: remoteLedOn
methods.description: Turns on the remote LED.

methods.name: remoteLedOff
methods.description: Turns off the remote LED.

methods.name: set24HourClock
methods.description: Configures clock display format.

methods.name: is24HourClock
methods.description: Checks if clock is in 24-hour format.

methods.name: onBlinkTimer
methods.description: Callback for blink timer expiry.

methods.name: setRemoteLedState
methods.description: Sets the state of remote LED in Helper class.
